findings.claim: The required committed lockfile is missing, so the pinned OpenSpec CLI requirement and npm-ci scenario are not satisfied.
findings.evidence: specs/project-tooling/spec.md Requirement: Pinned OpenSpec CLI says the project SHALL depend on @fission-ai/openspec as a devDependency pinned to an exact version with a committed package-lock.json; artifact states "package-lock.json is excluded from the diff as generated" and the git diff contains no package-lock.json.
